# @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1

This local bundle was obtained from the published `@pdf-lib/fontkit` npm package via unpkg. Upstream package metadata declares the MIT license, Andrew Dillon as author and Devon Govett as contributor.

- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pdf-lib/fontkit
- Fork source and license declaration: https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit
- Original project: https://github.com/foliojs/fontkit
- MIT license text: https://opensource.org/license/mit/

The upstream/fork README files and package metadata are retained alongside the bundle. Encoding/glyph tables elsewhere in `vendor` come from Mozilla PDF.js and retain their Apache-2.0 source notices. Liberation font notices are in `vendor/standard_fonts/LICENSE_LIBERATION`.
